status: TEMPLATE. Copy to PRECHECK_CONFIG.json and fill every <<FILL>> before the build. This file grants no authority.
how_to_use: derive_precheck_job.py reads seven things from this file: attempt, kind, source_zip, source_zip_sha256, tokenizer_source_zip, previous, existing_allocation_usd.
A value that still says <<FILL>> stops the build.

attempt is a whole number. For a pre-check job it is 1 to 4. For a development test it is 1 or 2. It is the suffix of the job id, the folder, the lease and the claim: cas-optionb-b1-precheck-p1 to -p4, or cas-optionb-b1-devtest-d1 and -d2. Use the lowest number that was never launched. The build stops if a lower number has no claim file, and if this number already has a folder, a lease or a claim.
kind is SEALED_PACKAGE, REHEARSAL or DEVELOPMENT_TEST. The seal file decides which one a package is. The build stops if this file says another kind.
SEALED_PACKAGE: source.zip was built after seal step 6, or after the last repair line 6R_PROGRAMS_REPAIRED. Only this kind returns values for seal step 7.

REHEARSAL (plan section 19.1): after seal step 5 and before seal step 6. source.zip was built with 'build_source_zip_b1.py --seal <scratch copy>'. It is one of the 4 jobs. Its result is never written to the real seal file.

DEVELOPMENT_TEST (plan section 19.1, amendment A10): made-up data, before seal step 1 exists. It is ordered: one job, at most two. Each has a cap of 0.50 USD and 45 minutes. It is outside the seal chain and is not one of the 4 pre-check jobs. Its job id is cas-optionb-b1-devtest-d<attempt>. It is authorised by the operator's decision of 2026-10-05 under the owner's approval record OWNER_APPROVAL_ALL_STAGES_20261005T0610Z.json. source.zip comes from optionb/dry/build_dev_package.py and holds made-up data only. Its output is never evidence about roles.

The block 'previous' names the job that most recently used the shared four-key storage slot. Read the bus and the ledger again on the day of the build. The build stops unless this job is the last job the ledger carries. For a second job of this kit it is normally the job of this kit before it.
existing_allocation_usd must equal combined_allocation_usd in the ledger pointer at the moment of the build. The build stops if it does not.
attempt: <<FILL NUMBER: 1, 2, 3 or 4 for a pre-check job; 1 or 2 for a development test. Write it as a number, without quotes.>>
